metric: util_pct[system] = 100 * T_bound_us / measured_latency_us[system]; T_bound_us = max over ranks of max(T_compute_us, T_memory_us, T_interconnect_us)
identity: util_pct[Weave] / util_pct[fastest baseline] == fastest_baseline_us / weave_us == Fig. 7 speedup

mi308x_bound_model.token_ownership: contiguous S // 16 tokens per rank (rank r owns tokens [r*S/16, (r+1)*S/16))
mi308x_bound_model.T_compute_us: p[r] * 6 * H * I / 398.7e12 * 1e6  (p = routed (token, expert) pairs on rank r; MI308X SKU peak)
mi308x_bound_model.T_memory_us: t[r] * 3 * H * I / 3684.0e9 * 1e6  (t = touched local experts, FP8 weights)
mi308x_bound_model.T_xgmi_us: max(xgmi_rx_bytes, xgmi_tx_bytes) / 287.194329e9 * 1e6  (same accounting vs same-node peers)
mi308x_bound_model.definitions: 'other' = ranks on the other node; rem_uniq_to_r = unique (token, r) hits from other-node tokens; own_disp_to_other = unique (own token, other-node rank) hits
